stem: Which sentence suggests that Brittany’s performance suffers because of Alix’s absence?

options.label: A
options.text: “I'm sorry, Brittany. I know you're great at gymnastics, but I was just trying to offer some advice.” (paragraph 4)

options.label: B
options.text: Five days had passed since Brittany had confronted Alix—and just two days were left until the competition. (paragraph 6)

options.label: C
options.text: “You seem off your game, Brit—and you need to get it together by Saturday morning.” (paragraph 8)

options.label: D
options.text: Brittany approached the edge of the mat with her head held high. (paragraph 15)
